prompt: Edit only the very top title/menu strip of this AgentHarbor desktop chat concept. It must be a consistent macOS desktop window: keep the existing red/yellow/green traffic lights at the far upper left; REMOVE all Windows minimize/maximize/X controls at the far upper right and leave that right edge empty. Add the legible small Chinese label “设计预览 · 示例数据” in the free title bar space to the right of the menu words, before the right edge. This label is essential to distinguish mockup task records from real execution. Do not move or modify the sidebar, meeting messages, right task inspector, typography in the body, input composer, icons, colors or any body content. Preserve exact dimensions and all other pixels as closely as possible. This is a desktop app mockup, not a website.
originalPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Design a complete actual DESKTOP CHAT APPLICATION window for AgentHarbor, a local multi-agent coding meeting app. Landscape 1536x1024. Native desktop title bar and window controls, compact toolbar, draggable split pane dividers, high-density desktop sidebar, independently scrolling conversation, stationary message composer, a permanently visible right inspector for tasks and results. NO browser address bar. NO web admin dashboard, NO big page heading, NO card grid, NO dashboard KPIs, NO vertical page landing layout. This is closer in interaction grammar to Slack desktop or a polished native AI chat app. Show product-specific assistant meeting activity instead of a generic chatbot. Palette is consistent cool white conversation surface, deep marine-blue project/meeting sidebar, blue selected meeting, teal passed evidence, amber review blocker. Use highly legible Chinese UI type, 14–16px normal content and clear 18px meeting title, compact conventional native-like desktop buttons, fine dividers, restrained radius. Product name “AgentHarbor”. Explicit visible label “设计预览 · 示例数据” in title area. Native menu/window chrome is functional looking. Bottom sidebar local indicator “本机引擎 · 已连接”, “模型认证 · 待验证”, do not imply this mock is real runtime evidence. Task example “修复登录重试”. Goal “会话过期后正确刷新，避免重复提交”. Meeting participants “主持人”, “Codex · 执行”, “Claude Code · 审核”. Conversation with concrete messages: 主持人 “先确认验收标准，再实现并验证。”; Codex “已修复刷新逻辑，登录回归 8/8 通过。”; Claude Code “缺少并发重试用例，暂不通过。”; 主持人 “交回 Codex 补测，验证通过后再次审核。” Show true pending task state “返工中 · 第 2 轮”, unfinished completion and specific blocker. Conversation actions link to task and evidence entries, not a huge flowchart. Right inspector has familiar tabs “任务” and “结果”, checkable acceptance criteria, active task assignment, “缺少并发重试用例”, verified test entry “登录回归 8/8” and file “session-retry.patch”. Fixed composer placeholder “描述目标，或 @助手加入讨论…”, attachment, participant selector and send button, plus a small “自动推进” switch and “暂停” control in toolbar. This is an honest future design concept, not a released UI. No decorative artwork or toy robots. Keep clear practical working controls and crisp typography, app fills the frame. Variant C, focused desktop conversation: 200px marine-blue workspace sidebar with project and meeting list, very wide airy center chat with subtle alternating message groups and a small header participant row. Right inspector is a permanent 320px narrow dock whose upper segment shows a compact task tree and lower segment has selected “结果” tab listing a code patch and actual test/review entries. Native macOS integrated toolbar rather than a website header. At center show a selected “交回执行” action message connected by the same small task ID to the highlighted item at right. The current task is in amber, result evidence is teal, independent review is visibly unresolved. Message composer is anchored to center bottom with a task context chip. Keep sidebar and inspector crisp and quiet; the discussion is the primary workspace. Different from A: broad conversation, narrow minimal sidebar, task tree rather than mission list, docked evidence result view.
note: Native macOS title bar and visible synthetic data label corrected
